bullets: Muse Spark 1.2 replaces 1.3 in the free model picker across CLI, Desktop, and Web after 1.3 returned model_not_found on all probes.
CLI model selector now shows a peak Freebucks pricing badge and tooltip for models marked costly by the server, ending in the reader's time zone.
End-session refunds and pending receipts now appear in the Freebuff session, showing a pending notice and the final returned amount.
Limited-tier model picker hero now leads with GLM 5.3 Flash while keeping DeepSeek V4 Flash as the always-joinable fallback.
Premium session base limit restored to 5 paid chat sessions per day, removing the retired Level-based override system.
Freebucks daily compute cap raised from 3x to 4x of Freebucks value for accounts using Freebucks.
Turn spend limit error message no longer speculates about assistant loops, stating only that the turn limit was reached.
Advertiser MCP tool calls now logged with advertiser ID, tool used, outcome, error code, and duration, excluding arguments and results.
Earn Freebucks page link text now reads 'Earn Freebucks · engage with a promoted post' across CLI, Desktop, and Web.
Imprezia ad fetch errors now log the first 300 characters of the response body for easier diagnosis.
